cant_tell: The header names no architecture. The key names are all there is, so this page doesn't name one.
7% of the weights sit in layers whose names don't say attention or MLP, such as fused or input layers, so they are left unsplit.
Some tensors are raw bytes (U8) with no format descriptor, so whether they pack several weights per byte isn't stated; each byte is counted as one.
How the width splits into attention heads isn't in the shapes. Only the metadata could say, and only when it does.
